description_expanded: ABOUT SAND WAND Welcome to Sand Wand - your serene retreat tucked away in the charming Seagrove Beach neighborhood along Florida's famed 30A corridor. This luxurious 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom private home blends coastal elegance with modern convenience, making it ideal for family getaways, couples' retreats, or a relaxing escape with friends. Enjoy upscale furnishings, multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, and a private pool framed by lush landscaping - the perfect place to unwind or entertain. With a location just a 5-minute walk to the beach, you'll experience the best of 30A without ever needing to hop in the car. Every detail has been curated for comfort and style. Prepare meals in the fully equipped kitchen or mix up cocktails at the full wet bar before stepping out onto your walkout balcony for a view of the pool and surrounding neighborhood. Stream your favorite shows on Smart TVs, connect easily with high-speed WiFi, and rest easy in five luxurious king ensuite bedrooms - including a spacious third-floor primary suite. Plus, there is also a queen sleeper sofa for additional guests. Whether you're pedaling to nearby coffee shops on your complimentary 4 bikes, soaking up the sun by the pool, or enjoying beach days just minutes away, Sand Wand promises an unforgettable stay along the Emerald Coast. ABOUT THE AREA Sand Wand is located in the sought-after Seagrove Beach community on the north side of 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. This area is known for its charming coastal neighborhoods, sugar-white sand beaches, and vibrant dining and shopping scenes. Hop on a bike and cruise to local favorites like Café Thirty-A or take a short drive to Seaside or Rosemary Beach. Whether you're paddleboarding on Western Lake, enjoying live music, or catching a sunset on the beach, the best of 30A is at your fingertips. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS * Private Pool * 5-Minute Walk to the Beach * 5 King Ensuite Bedrooms * Walkout Balcony with Pool View * Fully Equipped Kitchen & Full Wet Bar * Luxury Furnishings & Decor * Smart TVs & WiFi * Multiple Indoor & Outdoor Living Areas * 4 Complimentary Bikes * Private Garage + 4 Designated Parking Spots * Fenced Yard PARKING * 4 designated parking spots * Private garage access PROPERTY RULES * Maximum occupancy: 12 guests * Must be 25 years or older to book * No smoking inside or outside the home * No pets allowed * Rental agreement must be signed within 48 hours of booking * All reservations are non-refundable; travel insurance is strongly recommended ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our team is local and available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time.

Outdoor Features: Beach chairs available for guest use
